name: Source Data Registry Workflow
description: Child workflow compiled from Workbench container Source_Data_Workflow.

prompt_policy.user_prompt: Collect primary company disclosures, HKEX announcements, financial statements, segment data, share count, net cash/debt, and management guidance. Capture exact values with period/unit/currency and source ids. Do not analyze valuation. Output only compact evidence_pack items that are source-bound and metric-bound; move unverified or process details to blocking_gaps/data_gaps.

Collect current and historical market data needed for valuation: latest price timestamp, market cap, shares, FX, valuation multiples, consensus/public estimates if available, and liquidity. Mark missing paid-data fields as data gaps. Output only compact evidence_pack items that are source-bound and metric-bound; move unverified or process details to blocking_gaps/data_gaps.

Collect recent verified news, regulatory/policy items, product launches, litigation, macro policy, and catalysts. Separate verified sources from rumors. Create claim ids only for sourced facts. Output only compact evidence_pack items that are source-bound and metric-bound; move unverified or process details to blocking_gaps/data_gaps.

Collect industry and peer evidence: comparable companies, market share, margin/valuation benchmarks, competitive advantages, and business mix differences. Keep peer metrics source-bound. Output only compact evidence_pack items that are source-bound and metric-bound; move unverified or process details to blocking_gaps/data_gaps.
Merge only compact evidence_packs. Preserve source-bound metrics and claims; route unbound or low-quality items to blocking_gaps/data_gaps, not downstream evidence_pack.
